propositions: Documentation must be added to docs/config.md explaining that sync.remote accepts s3://bucket/prefix URLs served by the optional git-remote-s3 helper

A new operator guide docs/s3-backend.md must document installation, SSE-KMS bucket setup with IAM/CMK policy, git remote configuration, trust boundary (credentials from boto3 chain, encryption at rest), and auto-doctor self-heal behavior with 60s stale-lock TTL
An ADR 0093 must record the architecture decision to use git-remote-s3 below rebar's git layer, accept SSE-KMS encryption, implement merge-based auto-doctor, and reject TTL lowering

ADR indexing must be regenerated via scripts/gen_adr_index.py to create .numbers/0093 marker and update docs/adr/README.md, with both CI gates (gen_adr_index.py --check and check_adr_numbers.py) passing
Both new pages must be discoverable from docs/README.md with direct link to s3-backend.md and standard ADR discovery path through docs/adr/README.md
